Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim file purposes. Can you confirm you're
comfortable with us recording this call?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened on the day of the accident?
A: I was driving home on a two-lane road in Houston, going maybe twenty-five miles an hour. A car coming the other
way drifted into my lane while trying to pass a slow truck. I braked and turned, but we still met nose to nose. It wasn't
a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me forward and back.
Q: Did either airbag deploy?
A: No, nothing deployed. My seatbelt locked up and held me, though.
Q: Were you able to drive your car from the scene?
A: No. The front end was pushed in and the hood wouldn't close right, so a tow truck took it.
Q: Did you feel any pain or symptoms right away?
A: Not immediately. By that evening my neck was stiff, and by the next morning I had a dull ache across my shoulders
and a headache at the base of my skull. Turning my head to check mirrors hurts now.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the following day and was referred to a physcial therapist. I'm still going to sessions
twice a week.
Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this accident?
A: Nothing serious. I had some occasional stiffness from sitting at a desk, but I wasn't in treatment for anything.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've missed a few days of work because of the pain, and I'd like to be reimbursed for tohse and for my
therapy costs.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing with next steps.
A: Okay, thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
